stories.title: The U.S. and China to discuss artificial intelligence, tariffs, and critical minerals - 1News.az
stories.summary: The U.S. and China to discuss artificial intelligence, tariffs, and critical minerals U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng will hold talks in New York on Sunday. The two sides intend to discuss artificial intelligence, trade tariffs, and critical minerals. Representatives of the two countries are expected to try to prepare possible agreements that the leaders of the United States and China could then discuss. The issue of critical minerals is of particular importance.

stories.summary: Trump Announces New US Artificial Intelligence Forces, Citing Competition With China Donald Trump announced the creation of the United States AI Force on September 19. Trump said the new structure was being created along the lines of the US Space Force, which was established in 2019 during his first presidential term. I will announce its leader in the near future. – Donald Trump Trump called artificial intelligence a new industrial revolution Trump also called artificial intelligence “a new industrial revolution.” He said that in the future, the technology could account for 25% of the US gross domestic product.

stories.title: US, China Trade Teams Set to Huddle in New York on AI, Iran - Energy Connects
stories.summary: US, China Trade Teams Set to Huddle in New York on AI, Iran (Bloomberg) -- US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and China’s Vice Premier He Lifeng will lead talks on trade and other pressure points Sunday in New York ahead of next week’s summit between the leaders of the world’s two biggest economies. The negotiators will lay the groundwork for a high-profile meeting between President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping on Sept. 24 in Washington.
